items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: I've heard the records of Eddie South, and what's the name of this? The Feli in France? Grappoli, Stephen Grappoli.

ctx.x: Then along the line here, I would say around, I must have been no older than 12, maybe 11. We suddenly discovered there were other boys that were playing. We never had gotten together. Everybody was afraid to come out, afraid to show how little they knew. But finally, I went at an invitation to Bob and Harry Reynolds. They lived on Britannia Street, the corner of Marengo on the Uptown Woods Corner. And they asked me to bring my guitar. Well, I hid it in the bushes, and then I went on in and I listened to the two…
